entities.name: BAP Configuration Setup
entities.description: Procedure to establish and configure a BAP entity when bap-Config is set to setup.

entities.name: BAP Configuration Release
entities.description: Procedure to release the BAP entity when bap-Config is set to release.

entities.name: BAP Entity
entities.description: Backhaul Adaptation Protocol entity that handles backhaul routing and configuration.

entities.name: BAP Address
entities.description: Address used by the BAP entity for this node's identification in backhaul routing.

entities.name: Default UL BAP Routing ID
entities.description: Default uplink backhaul routing identifier applied to the BAP entity.

entities.name: Default UL BH RLC Channel
entities.description: Default uplink backhaul RLC channel configuration applied to the BAP entity.

entities.name: Flow Control Feedback Type
entities.description: Flow control feedback configuration applied to the BAP entity.

entities.name: IP Address Release
entities.description: Procedure to release IP addresses based on iab-IP-AddressToReleaseList.

entities.name: IP Address Addition/Modification
entities.description: Procedure to add or modify IP addresses based on iab-IP-AddressToAddModList.

entities.name: IAB IP Address Index
entities.description: Index identifying specific IP address configurations in IAB-MT.

entities.name: IAB IP Address Configuration
entities.description: Configuration storing IP addresses and associated parameters for IAB-MT.

entities.name: IAB IP Usage
entities.description: Specifies the traffic type (F1-C, F1-U, non-F1) for which an IP address is used.

entities.name: IAB Donor DU BAP Address
entities.description: BAP address of the IAB donor DU associated with an IP address configuration.

relations.description: BAP configuration setup procedure establishes a BAP entity.
BAP configuration setup configures the BAP entity to use the bap-Address.
BAP configuration setup applies the default UL BAP routing ID.
BAP configuration setup applies the default UL BH RLC channel if included.
BAP configuration setup applies flow control feedback if included.
BAP configuration release procedure releases the BAP entity.
IP address release procedure releases the corresponding IAB-IP-AddressConfiguration.
IP address addition/modification procedure adds or modifies IAB-IP-AddressConfiguration.
IP address addition/modification uses IAB-IP-Usage to determine traffic type storage.
IP address addition/modification stores IP addresses with associated IAB-donor-DU BAP address.
